messages:
mira: Customer BetaCo just asked if we can guarantee a PAYG tier SLO: P95 <= 250ms for text-gen, and fallback to an embedding-only response when requests exceed 1k tokens. They want this in the next quarter. Thoughts?
eli: gotta unpack tradeoffs. PAYG customers share pooled capacity; deterministic P95 is tough without reserved for them. We can aim for best-effort with routing prefs.
clare: BetaCo is small but high-volume spikes during reports. They'll churn if tail latency is bad. They explicitly asked for a hard SLA on P95.
jordan: from SRE perspective: hard SLA on shared capacity requires either throttles or dedicated capacity. Otherwise we need stricter autoscale/burst guarantees. Both add cost.
mira: proposal: define two options in PRD — 1) Soft SLO with visibility/alerts (default PAYG), 2) Paid SLO (month commit or dedicated) with hard latency target and fallbacks. Acceptance criteria should cover degraded-mode behavior.
sam: embedding fallback for very long contexts is clever but we must define UX and model mapping. If we switch to embeddings-only, quality of response will drop; need customer signoff. Also embeddings cost differs.
eli: implementation notes: detect token-length > threshold or tail latency prediction -> route to embedding pipeline + templated reply. Need guardrails so we don't silently degrade. Add response flag: "degraded_to_embeddings": true.
jordan: metrics to capture: request_id, original_model, fallback_trigger, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, error. We also need separate error budgets for degraded responses so product teams know user impact.
clare: BetaCo: they prefer automatic degrade over failed requests. They accept lower QoE if it's consistent and transparent.
mira: acceptance criteria draft: 1) PAYG soft SLO: P95 <= 250ms for 90% of customer days, with alerting when breached. 2) Paid SLO: P95 <= 250ms for 99% of requests after onboarding + signed commitment. 3) Degrade flow: when predicted tail latency > 500ms or tokens_in > 1k, return embedding fallback with flag and link to docs.
eli: edge cases: streaming responses — we can't atomically switch mid-stream. Need pre-check before start. Also function-calling flows might break if we serve embeddings only.
sam: agreed. Acceptance should explicitly ban degrade for function-calling requests or provide a different fallback. Also define test harness: sample prompt sets, human-eval of embedding fallback acceptability, and automated A/B comparing user satisfaction signals.
jordan: operational acceptance: canary rollout to 5% of PAYG traffic in EU region; burn-in for 72h with no more than 1.5x error budget usage. Add auto-rollback if tokenized fail rate > 0.5% in canary.
mira: prioritization ask: this is on roadmap v2.0 for Q2: do we bump up because BetaCo is likely to convert to enterprise on this?
clare: BetaCo is engaged with AE; they hinted they'd commit if we could provide paid SLO within 6 weeks. That's faster than our typical cycle.
eli: engineering capacity: building the detection + fallback + telemetry is ~3 sprints for eng + 1 sprint infra + evaluation. Dedicated SLO path (billing + legal) another 2 sprints cross-team.
sam: ML work: need a short eval to verify embeddings fallback preserves core intent for BetaCo's prompts. I can run 500 prompt pairs in 5 days.
mira: tradeoff decision for today: defer paid SLO pipeline vs build lightweight degrade feature for PAYG that surfaces flags and a clear downgrade message. Which do we prioritize?
jordan: ops vote: build lightweight degrade + telemetry first. It reduces immediate user pain and gives us data to justify paid SLO spend.
clare: CS vote: same. Gives BetaCo immediate runway and keeps them engaged.
eli: eng vote: ok to scope lightweight degrade as first milestone but need product to accept limited safe-guards: no degrade for function-calls, explicit opt-out flag, and max-degrade rate per org.
mira: decision logged: implement v1 degrade (detection + embedding fallback + flag + telemetry + canary) for PAYG. Parallel: legal/billing explore paid SLO contract path but not blocking BetaCo.
deploy-bot: deploy initiated: feature/degrade-payg -> staging at 2026-03-20T15:12:03Z
sam: I'll start the 500-prompt eval tomorrow and tag results in the RFC. Can we add acceptance criterion: median similarity >= 0.7 between original response intent and fallback embedding-based summary?
eli: technical acceptance: rollout success if canary latency P95 improves by 30% on degraded flows and no more than 0.5% of traffic hits fallback in baseline days.
mira: next steps: 1) eng to produce RFC with detection logic + metrics (Eli). 2) ML to run prompt eval (Sam). 3) CS to get BetaCo signoff on degrade UX (Clare). 4) SRE to define canary guardrails (Jordan). Due EOD Friday.
clare: I'll schedule a BetaCo call and send the degrade UX sample messages.
mira: thanks. If anyone sees blockers, flag in this thread. :raised_hands:\"
